meta.notes: An enchantment provider is a rule the game uses to enchant items it hands out itself. by_cost_with_difficulty enchants as an enchanting table would at a cost from min_cost up to min_cost plus max_cost_span, higher on harder local difficulty, picking from the enchantments listed. Vanilla uses providers such as minecraft:mob_spawn_equipment for the gear of spawned mobs and minecraft:raid/vindicator for raid axes. A project provider with one of those names replaces vanilla's; under a name of its own, like this one, nothing uses it yet.
